anchor_value: Purflux Holding S.A R.L. Term Loan principal 54,619 with EURIBOR reference rate; extracted principal_amount_usd is blank

findings.detail: Non-USD debt principal is present in the SOI row, but principal_amount_usd is blank, so explicit FX conversion is missing.

rationale: FX01 is a real data error. The bundle flags blank principal_amount_usd for non-USD debt rows; the cited SOI row shows a debt principal of 54,619 with EURIBOR as the reference rate, indicating a non-USD source par amount that requires an explicit USD principal conversion before par analytics. The observed extracted value is blank, so the missing converted principal is an extraction/conversion gap rather than a false alarm.
